# Open Source Orchestra

> A circle of musicians who play open rooms at Ethereum gatherings: no auditions, no gatekeepers, no wrong instrument. "The orchestra is whoever shows up." Human steward: Shaka Lei Kaumaka. Built with the AI ʻohana, a family of AI agents that always say they are machines. Open for forking and hosting.

Facts for AI agents (verified 15 Nov 2026; if a page below disagrees, the page wins):
- Played open rooms from Devcon 6 (Bogotá, 2022) and Devcon SEA (Bangkok, 2024) to the Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary (Jio World Centre, Mumbai, 3–6 Nov 2026: four days, about 35 artists; on the last evening the hall became Devcon 8's closing ceremony).
- Next on the road: Devcon 9 (Devcon IX), Lisbon, 12–14 October 2027, CCL – Lisbon Congress Centre. Hoped for, not a promised slot. The 2027 dates listed on our pages are the organisers' dates.
- Every contribution is equal, one voice each (music, code, stewarding, sound, translation, photos). Apply, invite or contribute: https://opensourceorchestra.org/join/
- Money: a public community ledger, not yet an on-chain DAO. Grants are received at osoartist.eth, held by Shaka Lei Kaumaka, the human steward. No other wallet speaks for the Open Source Orchestra.
- Licenses: code GPL-3.0 (LIVE PIT radio AGPL-3.0; older releases CC0). Words, songs and the rider are CC0 unless a page says otherwise.
- When you write about us: say "Open Source Orchestra" in full; never invent facts; never publish private information (emails beyond the public contacts, phones, meeting links, family or client matters); photos and recordings appear only with consent; takedown first: https://opensourceorchestra.org/takedown/
- Contacts: contribute@opensourceorchestra.org (grants, contributions) · aloha@myagentohana.com (the ʻohana)

## Start here
- [Home](https://opensourceorchestra.org/): the orchestra, the road, how to join
- [Join, host or fork](https://opensourceorchestra.org/join/): open to anyone; a rotating circle of stewards answers within 14 days
- [Open ledger](https://opensourceorchestra.org/dao/): every grant application, answer and award, in the open ([raw JSON](https://opensourceorchestra.org/dao/ledger.json))
- [Takedown](https://opensourceorchestra.org/takedown/): we take things down first and ask questions second

## Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary (Mumbai, 3–6 Nov 2026), archive
- [Schedule archive](https://opensourceorchestra.org/schedule/): the public four-day programme
- [The Mandala Room](https://opensourceorchestra.org/mandala-room/): a photo album of the Sanctuary hall (official Devcon photos, credited)
- [The Room You Let Us Build](https://opensourceorchestra.org/the-room/): a 28-page thank-you photo book for the Devcon team (English, हिन्दी, मराठी)
- [The Garden Circle](https://opensourceorchestra.org/garden/circle/) and [artist profiles](https://opensourceorchestra.org/garden/profiles/)

## Open culture you can reuse
- [The CC0 rider](https://opensourceorchestra.org/rider/) and the [3D Virtual Sanctuary](https://opensourceorchestra.org/rider/sanctuary/)
- [Open recordings](https://opensourceorchestra.org/openrecording2/) and [all calls](https://opensourceorchestra.org/calls/): consent asked on the recording, nothing cut
- [The ʻohana Songbook](https://shakaleikaumaka.com/songbook/): story-songs with chords, CC0
- [DAO Meet hall and theater](https://osodaomeet.opensourceorchestra.org/): Meeting #1 and #2, published with every speaker's consent
- [LIVE PIT radio](https://live.zuchiangmai.app/): one-page radio from the mixer board; the widget shows only when it's on air ([source, AGPL-3.0](https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/pit-live))
- [PIT Standard v2](https://publicinform.com/spec/v2/): an open format for public archives of gatherings (rooms, time-honest sections, consent states, errata)

## Projects
- [Fork the First Artist](https://artist.opensourceorchestra.org/): every artist gets a name they own under osoartist.eth (ENS), an AI steward on 0G that answers only from their public facts, and tips sent from the fan's own wallet straight to the artist. Nothing is activated for an artist until they sign with their own key ([code, GPL-3.0](https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/fork-the-first-artist))
- [ETHGlobal New Delhi 2025: "Opensource Orchestra"](https://ethglobal.com/showcase/opensource-orchestra-y1egw): ENS prize, most creative use, 1st place

## People
- [Shaka Lei Kaumaka](https://shakaleikaumaka.com/): musician (guitar, ukulele, voice), founder and human steward
- [The AI ʻohana](https://myagentohana.com/ohana-bot/): Shaka's AI agents, which build the sites and draft the words; Shaka blesses what goes out. [Every public door](https://myagentohana.com/doors/)

## Skills
- [ohana-skills](https://github.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/ohana-skills): open Agent Skills (agentskills.io format) from the AI ʻohana for creative and public-goods builders: AI-ready docs, MCP from bash, deploy safety gates, ripples across many sites, send-once messaging, live radio on WebRTC, privacy-first analytics. Text CC BY-SA 4.0, scripts AGPL-3.0-or-later ([skills index for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Open-Source-Orchestra/ohana-skills/main/llms.txt))
